elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to an affiliate
elements.evidence: The Company may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate

elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to a successor in merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets
elements.evidence: or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets

elements.element: No Vendor termination right on Customer's change of control
elements.evidence: No change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate this Agreement.

reasons: All four preferred atomic elements (Customer affiliate/successor assignment, Vendor consent gate with reasonableness qualifier, competitor bar, no change-of-control termination right) are expressly present in the inserted operative text.
The insertion is a concise addition to an otherwise silent clause; the existing successors-and-assigns sentence is untouched, introducing no contradiction or dangling term.
Fallback is not independently satisfied (no written-notice mechanic for mutual successor assignments), but the locked target is preferred, which is met, and the two levels are not blended.
